name: askfiles
description: Search and browse your own documents with a local model.

scripts.build: npm run build:main && npm run build:upstream
scripts.package:mac: npm run build:main && PACKAGE_TARGET=mac-arm64 bash scripts/build.sh && electron-builder --config electron-builder.yml --mac dir --arm64 && bash scripts/sign-adhoc.sh && electron-builder --config electron-builder.yml --mac dmg --arm64 --prepackaged release/mac-arm64/AskFiles.app
